    <div>
      <label for="phone">Phone number <span aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>

        id="phone"
        name="phone"
        type="tel"
        inputmode="tel"
        autocomplete="tel"
        placeholder="+1 (555) 123-4567"
        required
        aria-required="true"
        aria-describedby="phone-hint phone-error"
        pattern="^\+?[\d\s().-]{7,}$"
        maxlength="25"

      <div id="phone-error" role="alert" aria-live="polite"></div>
    </div>
